drivers.theme: Fed hike and rates near cycle highs
Oil supply shock and pipeline outage
Rich tech valuations, lack of earnings support, seasonality
China AI race and resilient capex/ROI offset

parsed.rationale: Weekend AI-safety calls hit chip/AI leadership, while a near-certain Fed hike, oil spike and rich tech valuations keep Nasdaq risk skewed lower. Some offset from software rotation and arguments the AI slowdown is marginal, but the tape and macro backdrop favor caution over 1-7 days.
